data.name: Filbert
data.gender_notes: Filbert is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German word ‘filibrant’, meaning ‘strong, powerful, and ruler’. The name Filbert is a variant of the name Philip, which has Greek origins and means ‘lover of horses’. The name Filbert can also be associated with the bright and radiant qualities of the filbert nut tree. The name Filbert carries the meaning “Strong, ruler, bright” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Filbert usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, ruler, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Filbert belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, ruler, bright.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Filbert total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_greek.name: Φίλμπερτ
in_greek.long_meaning: Φίλμπερτ είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα γερμανικής προέλευσης, που σημαίνει 'λαμπρή λόγχη' ή 'λόγχη που λάμπει'. Το όνομα αποτελείται από δύο λέξεις: 'φίλος' που σημαίνει 'λόγχη' και 'μπερτ' που σημαίνει 'λαμπρός' ή 'λαμπρή'. Το όνομα αυτό δόθηκε για να εκφράσει την ελπίδα και το φως.

in_latin.name: Filbert

in_english.name: Filbert
in_english.meaning: Filbert means bright spear or shining spear
in_english.long_meaning: Filbert is a Christian name of Germanic origin, meaning 'bright spear' or 'shining spear'. Derived from the Old High German words 'fil' (spear) and 'bert' (bright or shining), the name Filbert symbolizes strength, courage, and illumination. Historically, the name Filbert has been associated with Saint Filbert of Tiron, a 7th-century French abbot and hermit. The name is less common today but still holds spiritual significance in Christian traditions, reflecting qualities of leadership, protection, and enlightenment.
